question: An airplane is in level flight at an altitude of 1.5 km from the ground is observed at an angle of elevation of 60°. After 10 seconds, its angle of elevation is observed to be 30°. The speed of the airplane in km/hr is:
solution:
**Given:**

Height h = 1.5 km

Angles = 60°, 30°

Time = 10 sec

**Formula used:**

tanθ = h ÷ base ⇒ base = h ÷ tanθ

 
• 
• 
• 60° 
• 
• 30° 1.5 km 
• √3 km 

**Calculations:**

⇒ x₁ = 1.5 ÷ √3

⇒ x₂ = 1.5√3

⇒ Distance = 1.5√3 − (1.5 ÷ √3)

⇒ = (4.5 − 1.5) ÷ √3 = 3 ÷ √3 = √3 km

⇒ Speed = (√3 ÷ 10) km/sec

⇒ Convert to km/hr ⇒ √3 × 360 = 360√3 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 360√3 km/hr.**
